# Providence Family Dentistry

> A comprehensive family dental practice in Mableton, GA led by Dr. Tampa L. Rhodes Bell, offering preventative care, cosmetic dentistry, restorative procedures, and specialized services including pediatric dentistry and emergency care.

Providence Family Dentistry serves the Mableton, Georgia community with a full range of dental services from routine checkups to complex full-mouth reconstructions. The practice emphasizes family-friendly care with specialized pediatric services and modern treatment options like Invisalign clear aligners.
